0.original: The affable Kojin gazes at you with large, pondering eyes.

26.original: Obtain seabed treasure from the roots of large seaweed stalks.

27.original: Deliver the seabed treasures to the affable Kojin.

48.original: Oh, would you look at that! We have a visitor, and not just any visitor but one from the above!

49.original: Might I ask you help with something? You see, I would like to go treasure hunting but need someone to accompany me. If I go with one of the other villagers, they will try to take more than their fair share of our find.

50.original: You from the surface, however, have no interest in treasure, only koban. For your help you shall receive a handsome sum, so what do you say? If you are willing to join me, meet me outside the Tamamizu gates in a quarter bell.

51.original: Thank you for coming, my good <hex:02080EE905FF056C616479FF0473697203>! Before we begin hunting for treasure in earnest, let us go over the basics. Do you see those great columns of seaweed below us?

52.original: Treasures are often carried into the areas surrounding our village by the ocean currents and become entangled in the roots and stalks of larger clumps of plants like those.

53.original: If you do a bit of tugging on the stalks and rummage about the roots, treasure should appear! Go ahead, and give it a try!

54.original: Try digging about the roots and looking at the stalks of those large columns of weeds over there.

55.original: Excellent work, for a beginner! Now let us move on to doing some actual treasure hunting! Oh, and remember not to waste your time searching the smaller clumps of grass. Treasures rarely─if ever─get stuck in them.

56.original: Please go and search the waters near Sui<hex:021F0103>no<hex:021F0103>Sato and to the rear of our village. I shall poke about the other areas.

57.original: Once you have collected all the treasure to be found there, I ask that you return to Tamamizu and deliver them to me there.

58.original: So how did the hunting go?

59.original: You have brought back a bounty of porcelain plates, bottles and look─this is a torn zabuton cushion! This is one of the rarer treasures I have possessed to date!

60.original: Ah, but you bore of this talk. After all, your kind only has an eye for koban. That you would not desire to own such exquisite objects─you are a very strange people, indeed.

61.original: I suppose, however, I must be thankful for it because that means all the more treasure for us! Haha! Thank you for your help in gathering these for me, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. I cannot wait to take them home!
